==English==
{{wp}}
[[File:Extension cord.JPG|thumb|right|Yellow NEMA 5-15 extension cord]]

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-extension cord.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|electronics|US}} An electrical [[cord]] with a plug one end, and a single socket or a multi-port socket at the other end, used for powering one or more devices at a distance, too far from the wall outlet to be reached by the normal cords of the device or devices.
#* {{RQ:Harper Lee Mockingbird|chapter=15|passage=Atticus did something that interested us: he came into the livingroom carrying a long electrical '''extension cord'''. There was a light bulb on the end.}}

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|extension lead}} (UK)
* {{l|en|extension}}
* {{l|en|power extender}}
* {{l|en|drop cord}}
* {{l|en|trip cord}} (slang)
